attributes.Title: Kimi ni Koisuru Satsujinki
attributes.Synopsis:
Suzuki Ryuto is an introverted, timid college student. Every day he puts on a fake smile, trying his best to blend into a group of outgoing students even despite cruel teasing over his virginity.
One day he comes to a drinking party where he meets a beautiful girl, Kokoa. Per her request, he pretends to be her boyfriend to ward off the stalker who has been harassing the girl. Their tender love leads to great tragedy.
attributes.Author: AKIYAMA Enma

attributes.Title: The Exiled Cheating Magician Enjoys a Carefree Second Life. ~I can Grant “Reinforcement Points” Not Only to Weapons, But to Anything, and I Can Revoke the Effects at Any Time I Choose. But Are Those Left Behind Okay?~
attributes.Synopsis: Rain, an enhancement grantor who strengthens equipment and supports his fellow guild members, is expelled from the guild for the selfish reason that he has already strengthened all their equipment. Rain, who had been able to retrieve the enhancement magic just in case, retrieves all the magical power he had used on the guild's enhanced equipment. With an enormous amount of enhancement magic power in hand, Rain decides to enhance the copper sword and cloth clothes he has on hand for the time being...? A cheat great adventure starting from the weakest equipment!
attributes.Author: ROKUSHIMA Asa
